reason: As someone who saw the last campaign end in refunds and just gave to the ambulance fund, I trust A more because it tells me up front that the roof estimate could rise by 15% and promises a spending report every three months at the library. B's "$7.50 each" and "only $2,000 more than last time" are persuasive, but B leaves out the roof risk and the reporting promise, so it feels more like salesmanship.
